title: ISO Command Centre v2.9.1 · WhatsApp Business
description: Adds the WhatsApp Business module (Meta WhatsApp Cloud API): shared inbox, templates, media, broadcasts, employee opt-ins and automatic notifications. The install creates the WhatsApp tables, settings and permissions and adds WhatsApp to bootstrap/providers.php and the menu (backups are kept). Roll Back removes all of it, including WhatsApp messages and contacts.
changelog: Shared WhatsApp inbox with live refresh, sent/delivered/read ticks, media, templates and 24-hour service window enforcement.
Signed webhook receiver for inbound messages and delivery statuses; STOP/START consent keywords; optional auto-reply.
Employee opt-in directory with bulk consent recording.
Template sync from Meta (positional and named parameters).
Broadcasts to employees, departments or roles (opted-in only), with personalisation and delivery stats.
Automatic notifications: leave approved/declined, employee document expiry, vehicle document expiry to the assigned driver.
Cron URL for queued sends, retries and reminders. Settings page with encrypted credentials and a connection test.
New WhatsApp permission module. System Administrator gets all; Directors get inbox, opt-ins, broadcasts and templates; Managers get inbox and replies.
